description: A bar chart of daily active energy whose tooltip shows a name, value and kcal unit through a custom formatter.
overview: Uses `BarChart` with one `Bar` (`dataKey="energy"`, `radius={4}`, `maxBarSize={26}`). `chartData` takes the last seven of fourteen values and maps them into `{ date, energy }` records, with `date` as a `YYYY-MM-DD` string from `dayKey`; the `XAxis` formats it as a short weekday. `chartConfig.energy` uses `var(--red)`. The tooltip is `ChartTooltipContent` with `hideLabel` and a `formatter` that returns the name, the value formatted with `toLocaleString`, and `kcal`. `ChartTooltip` sets `defaultIndex={3}` so the tooltip is visible on load, and `cursor={false}`; the chart's top `margin` of 70 leaves room for it above the bars.
usage: Replace the value array and dates with your own data, keeping `date` and `energy` or renaming them in the axis and bar. Edit the `formatter` to change the label text and unit. A custom `formatter` replaces the whole row, so include the indicator yourself if you need one.
notes: The `XAxis` parses dates at noon (`T12:00:00`) to avoid shifting to the previous day in time zones behind UTC. `accessibilityLayer` is set on the chart, so the plot is focusable and arrow keys move the tooltip between categories.
